privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.controllerText: The controller for personal data processed on this platform is {company}, {address}, {email}.
privacy.controllerScope: This policy covers the {service} learning platform, including sign-in, course use and the emails that go with it.
privacy.dataIntro: We only process data that running the learning platform requires:
privacy.dataAccount: Account data: name, email address, your role within the respective tenant and a password hash — we never see the password itself.
privacy.dataProgress: Learning progress: completed lessons, quiz and exam attempts with results, submissions and grades, issued certificates.
privacy.dataContent: Your own input: submissions, notes, bookmarks and messages to trainers and to the AI tutor.
privacy.dataPayment: Payment data for paid courses: billing details and payment status. Card details are processed solely by our payment provider and never reach our servers.
privacy.dataSupport: Support requests: the content of your message and the contact details you provide with it.
privacy.dataTechnical: Technical access data: IP address, timestamp, page requested, browser and device type — for operation, security and troubleshooting.
privacy.purposeContract: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): providing your account, running courses, tracking progress, issuing certificates and processing purchases.
privacy.purposeLegitimate: Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): platform security, protection against abuse and bots, troubleshooting and improving the product based on aggregated usage.
privacy.purposeConsent: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): optional details such as a profile picture, and the messages you send to the AI tutor. You can withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future.
privacy.purposeObligation: Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR): retention of invoices and accounting records.
privacy.aiText: The tutor chat and automatic course preparation use a language model provided by Anthropic. AI answers are labelled as AI assistant in the interface (Art. 50 EU AI Act). What is transmitted is your question, the related course excerpt and the conversation so far.
privacy.aiNoTraining: Your input is not used to train AI models. There is no automated decision producing legal effects within the meaning of Art. 22 GDPR — submissions are always graded by a person.
privacy.processorsIntro: We use selected service providers, each under a data processing agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR:

processor.hosting: Supabase — database, authentication and file storage, hosted in AWS Frankfurt (EU)
processor.video: Bunny.net — video hosting and delivery, EU library
processor.payment: Stripe — payment processing for paid courses
processor.email: Resend — transactional emails such as invitations, password resets and notifications
processor.ai: Anthropic — language model for the tutor chat and course preparation
processor.embeddings: Voyage AI — turning course content into vectors for semantic search
processor.cdn: Cloudflare — application delivery and protection against attacks

privacy.transferText: {company} is based in the USA, and some providers also process data outside the EU. We base these transfers on the European Commission standard contractual clauses (Art. 46(2)(c) GDPR) together with additional measures such as encryption in transit and at rest. The database and the videos remain in the EU.
privacy.cookiesText: We only set strictly necessary cookies: the sign-in session cookie (httpOnly, Secure, SameSite) and your language choice. No tracking, no advertising cookies, no sharing with ad networks. Sessions expire automatically once the configured lifetime is reached.
privacy.botText: Publicly accessible forms — sign-in, registration, password reset and the contact form — are protected against automated bulk requests. For this we process the IP address of the request, the time of submission and the content of the form: we limit the number of requests per IP address, per sender address and per recipient mailbox, and we check automatically whether a message shows the hallmarks of machine-generated advertising. Messages classified as spam are neither delivered nor stored; only the fact that a request was rejected is logged, without the message content. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in preventing abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.botTurnstile: On the contact form we additionally use Cloudflare Turnstile. It evaluates technical characteristics of the request in the browser and only presents a challenge in case of doubt. The IP address and information about browser and device are transmitted to Cloudflare in the process. Turnstile sets no cookies, serves no advertising purpose and builds no user profiles. Cloudflare is our processor; for the transfer to the USA the section “Transfers to third countries” applies.
privacy.retentionText: We keep account data and learning progress for as long as the account exists. After deletion we remove the data unless a statutory retention duty applies; invoices are kept for the statutory period. Technical logs are deleted after a short time.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection (Art. 15–21 GDPR).
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise them, write to {email}. We answer within the statutory deadline.
privacy.complaintText: You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, usually the one where you habitually reside.
privacy.changesText: We update this policy when our processing changes. The version published here, with the date shown above, is the one that applies.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.scopeText: These terms govern your use of the {service} learning platform. Your contracting party is {company}, {address}.
terms.servicesText: We provide an online learning platform: courses with video and text lessons, quizzes and exams, graded submissions, progress tracking, certificates and AI-assisted help. Which of these are enabled depends on the plan booked.
terms.accountText: Use requires a personal account. The details you give must be accurate; an account is personal and must not be shared.
terms.accountSecurityText: Keep your credentials confidential. If you suspect unauthorised access, tell us without delay.
terms.pricesText: Paid courses show their price and scope before purchase. Payment runs through our payment provider, and access is unlocked once payment succeeds.
terms.withdrawalHeading: Right of withdrawal for digital content
terms.withdrawalText: Consumers in the EU and EEA generally have a 14-day right of withdrawal. For digital content with immediate access it expires as soon as you expressly agree that we may begin performance before the period ends and acknowledge that you thereby lose your right of withdrawal.
terms.withdrawalContactText: A clear statement sent to {email} is enough to withdraw.
terms.contentText: Course content is protected by copyright. You receive a simple, non-transferable right to use it for your own training. Sharing, copying, recording or making it publicly available is not permitted without the consent of {company} or of the respective provider.
terms.contentUserText: You keep the rights to your own submissions and contributions. You grant us the right to process them in order to run the course — for grading, feedback and proof of completion.
terms.aiText: AI answers are labelled as such and are meant as learning support. They can be incomplete or wrong and do not replace professional, legal or medical advice. Grades and certificates are always the responsibility of a person.
terms.availabilityText: We aim for continuous availability but do not owe it without interruption. Maintenance windows and outages at upstream providers can limit access temporarily. We announce planned maintenance in advance where possible.
terms.conductText: In particular, automated scraping of content, circumventing technical protection measures, attacks on the platform and posting unlawful content are prohibited. We may suspend access in case of serious breaches.
terms.liabilityText: We are liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence and for injury to life, body or health. For ordinary negligence we are liable only for breach of material contractual duties, limited to the damage typically foreseeable for this type of contract. Mandatory statutory liability remains unaffected.
terms.terminationText: Free accounts can be deleted at any time. Paid access runs for the agreed period; both sides keep the right to terminate for good cause.
terms.lawText: The laws of the State of Wyoming, USA apply, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods.
terms.consumerText: For consumers habitually resident in the EU or EEA this choice of law applies only in so far as it does not deprive them of the protection of mandatory provisions of their country of residence (Art. 6(2) Rome I). They may also bring proceedings before the court at their place of residence.
terms.changesText: We may change these terms with effect for the future. We announce material changes by email in advance.
